expert_strategy_standard: Source-backed standard: follow Google Ads Help for match types, search terms, negatives, Target ROAS readiness, Quality Score, ad quality, and account keyword prioritization; follow Pinterest Business for lower-funnel product creative and clickthrough consistency; follow OpenAI/Anthropic agent guidance for clear instructions, guardrails, evals, and simple accountable workflows.

North Star: get customers to buy, with as many profitable paid-growth sales as possible at about 650% ROAS; impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, ad strength, and Quality Score are diagnostics only.
High-intent and low-waste rule: cheap traffic is useful only when the query, product, ad, landing page, and measurement path can plausibly produce profitable purchases.
No-rookie-mistake rule: do not broaden traffic, raise bids, add negatives, or scale from stale evidence, watchlists, vanity metrics, or unclear product/landing quality.
